note: Default editorPois loaded into aop_editor_pois_v1 on a fresh install or Reset viewer. Update workflow: draw → Export GeoJSON in the Map editor section → replace this file with the downloaded aop_editor_features.geojson → commit. Every feature gains properties.source = aop_editor_seed_v1 at load time. The optional seed_tag property writes a #tag binding into aop_feature_tags_v1 for the matching feature id; existing bindings on other layers carrying the same tag are stripped (the seed wins).

properties.name: AOP Pavilion
properties.description: Main pavilion at 1010 Ellis Cove Road. G-Central / event registration anchor. The #pavilion tag bound to this POI resolves the event schedule's pavilion entries to this point — previously bound to the underlying FEMA building footprint (build_id 3397585); migrated here so the binding lives on a first-class editor POI rather than a 9-patch reference layer.
